title: robots: pieces on a shared tray
summary: Two robots fill a tray with room for two pieces of each kind; a third needs all four at once.
hints: Counters `t1` and `t2` (pieces on the tray), one mutex and one condition variable for everything.
R1 waits while `t1 == 2`, R2 while `t2 == 2`, R3 while it does not have `t1 == 2 && t2 == 2`. Always wait inside a `while` loop.
To stop: when R3 has made `N` pieces it sets a `done` flag and broadcasts; R1 and R2 check the flag every time they wake up. Do not forget that they may be waiting at that moment.
Record the largest value of `t1` and `t2` (under the mutex) to check that the tray was never overfull.
